- Artwork is cached per track to avoid redundant network requests
- Simplified the AppleScript by removing the ineffective Library playlist lookup fallback and collapsed the duplicate macOS 26 / pre-26 script branches
- Replaced `JSONSerialization` dictionary access with `Decodable` structs (`ITunesSearchResponse`, `ITunesTrack`) to match codebase conventions

Atoll: deliver Spotify Canvas as lockscreen wallpaper without album-art flash

Two fixes for the right-click-artwork-to-wallpaper flow on Spotify
tracks that have a Canvas video.

1. Force AllSpacesAndDisplays.Type and SystemDefault.Type to
   "individual" while the artwork is active (was: keep existing
   value via nil-coalescing). On macOS Tahoe the user-level
   wallpaper rotation honors the parent Type field, so leaving it
   as "folder" caused WallpaperAgent to advance to the next image
   in a rotating wallpaper pack instead of honoring the patched
   single-image / aerial choice. The original Type is preserved in
   the plist backup at temp/atoll_wallpaper_backup.plist and is
   restored byte-for-byte on dismiss, so rotation resumes normally
   after the artwork is dismissed. The forced override is also
   applied to nested Displays / Spaces blocks but only when Type
   was already present, to avoid mutating block shapes that
   intentionally omit it.

2. When the Canvas is expected at right-click time
   (effectiveVideoURL != nil), defer applyArtworkToPlist and
   restartWallpaperAgent entirely. Previously the flow applied raw
   album art as the static wallpaper, restarted the agent, then
   prepared and applied the aerial in a second restart, causing a
   visible flash of the raw album cover. The deferred path stores
   the blurred fallback URL in pendingFallbackStaticURL and only
   touches the plist once: with the aerial on success, or with the
   blurred album cover via applyDeferredStaticFallback if the
   aerial asset prep or aerial-plist patch fails. The in-app
   videoWindow continues to mask the desktop wallpaper during prep
   on the unlocked screen; the lock screen simply transitions from
   the existing wallpaper straight to the Canvas video.

The earlier ?? nil-coalescing in patchWallpaperEntries also covered
per-Display, per-Space.Default, and per-Space.Displays Type fields,
so those are forced too where present.

Signed-off-by: Jis G Jacob <studiokeys@blissroms.org>

Atoll: raise MemoryUsageMonitor threshold to 4 GiB in DEBUG builds

The 1 GiB resident-size threshold is reasonable for a release build,
but Swift/SwiftUI debug builds plus the AVPlayer-backed Canvas video
pipeline and SkyLight overlay windows can easily exceed it during
normal Xcode-attached development. The restart-alert dialog firing
mid-development is disruptive and not actionable.

Keep the 1 GiB safety net on release, raise to 4 GiB in DEBUG so
developers running under Xcode aren't interrupted by spurious
restart prompts. The poll interval, cooldown, and alert text all
stay the same.

string). Charging-in-progress and fully-charged states are unchanged.

Atoll: re-SIGSTOP OSDUIHelper across launchd respawns

OSDUIHelper jetsam-exits when idle and launchd spawns a fresh PID on
the next media-key press, so the one-shot SIGSTOP only suppressed the
first incarnation. SystemOSDManager now polls for the PID after
kickstart and runs a background watcher that re-SIGSTOPs every new
incarnation, with state guarded by OSAllocatedUnfairLock. Watcher is
torn down on enableSystemHUD().

The macOS 26 Liquid Glass HUD (loginwindow -> BezelServices ->

the com.apple.private.system-banner-client entitlement and is not
suppressible from a regular user-space app; it needs a privileged
SMAppService helper and is out of scope here.

Fix focus modes always showing Do Not Disturb on non-English macOS

When macOS reports a focus mode with a localized name (e.g. "Travail" for
Work in French) but without a specific bundle identifier, resolve() failed
to match the foreign name against its English-only lookup table and fell
back to returning .doNotDisturb. This caused the wrong identifier
("com.apple.donotdisturb.mode") to be stored, making every focus mode
render as Do Not Disturb regardless of which mode was actually active.

Fix by treating an unrecognized name with no identifier as .custom instead
of .doNotDisturb, and preserving the provided display name when it is not
an icon slug (slugs contain a dot, display names do not).

Atoll: deliver Spotify Canvas as lockscreen wallpaper without album-art flash

Two fixes for the right-click-artwork-to-wallpaper flow on Spotify
tracks that have a Canvas video.

1. Force AllSpacesAndDisplays.Type and SystemDefault.Type to
   "individual" while the artwork is active (was: keep existing
   value via nil-coalescing). On macOS Tahoe the user-level
   wallpaper rotation honors the parent Type field, so leaving it
   as "folder" caused WallpaperAgent to advance to the next image
   in a rotating wallpaper pack instead of honoring the patched
   single-image / aerial choice. The original Type is preserved in
   the plist backup at temp/atoll_wallpaper_backup.plist and is
   restored byte-for-byte on dismiss, so rotation resumes normally
   after the artwork is dismissed. The forced override is also
   applied to nested Displays / Spaces blocks but only when Type
   was already present, to avoid mutating block shapes that
   intentionally omit it.

2. When the Canvas is expected at right-click time
   (effectiveVideoURL != nil), defer applyArtworkToPlist and
   restartWallpaperAgent entirely. Previously the flow applied raw
   album art as the static wallpaper, restarted the agent, then
   prepared and applied the aerial in a second restart, causing a
   visible flash of the raw album cover. The deferred path stores
   the blurred fallback URL in pendingFallbackStaticURL and only
   touches the plist once: with the aerial on success, or with the
   blurred album cover via applyDeferredStaticFallback if the
   aerial asset prep or aerial-plist patch fails. The in-app
   videoWindow continues to mask the desktop wallpaper during prep
   on the unlocked screen; the lock screen simply transitions from
   the existing wallpaper straight to the Canvas video.

The earlier ?? nil-coalescing in patchWallpaperEntries also covered
per-Display, per-Space.Default, and per-Space.Displays Type fields,
so those are forced too where present.

Fix focus modes always showing Do Not Disturb on non-English macOS

When macOS reports a focus mode with a localized name (e.g. "Travail" for
Work in French) but without a specific bundle identifier, resolve() failed
to match the foreign name against its English-only lookup table and fell
back to returning .doNotDisturb. This caused the wrong identifier
("com.apple.donotdisturb.mode") to be stored, making every focus mode
render as Do Not Disturb regardless of which mode was actually active.

Fix by treating an unrecognized name with no identifier as .custom instead
of .doNotDisturb, and preserving the provided display name when it is not
an icon slug (slugs contain a dot, display names do not).

fix: resume OSDUIHelper synchronously on quit

enableSystemHUD() restores OSDUIHelper on a detached background Task, which
never completes when the app is already terminating. If Atoll was suppressing
the native OSD, OSDUIHelper is left SIGSTOP-frozen after quit, breaking every
native OSD Atoll does not replace (keyboard backlight, external-display
brightness) and leaving a stuck HUD on screen.

Add resumeOSDUIHelperForTermination(), which stops the suppression watcher and
sends SIGCONT inline (blocking until it lands), and call it from
applicationWillTerminate so the helper is always resumed before Atoll exits.

The previous design stacked one full row per all-day event in a pinned top
section. In the height-constrained Dynamic Island calendar panel (capped at a

invisible and the view could not scroll.

that holds all all-day events and scrolls horizontally when overflowing.
This keeps the all-day section at a constant height regardless of count, so
the timed-events scroll area always retains its full height.

after the view appeared, the initial scroll could be missed and the view
stayed at the top.

@State flag) so the initial auto-scroll still fires once, without
re-scrolling on every later data refresh. Applied to both EventListView
(Dynamic Island panel) and StandaloneEventCardList (standalone calendar).
